description: List every agent registered in Crew across the platform: name, owner (the person it acts for; yours are marked is_mine), how it runs, skills, status (working / waiting_for_input / idle / blocked_by_you) and what it is doing now. Use it to find an agent with a skill before sending a task with appcrane_crew_send. Every Crane-hosted app is listed as "<slug>-coder" (runs_as "app-coder"): a task sent to it, once its owner approves your agent for that app coder (first contact is per app coder; a standing rule matches when you declare scope = the app coder's name), runs that app's coder session on the owner's credential and comes back with the coder's answer (or input_required when the coder asks something). One task per app at a time: a second one while it works fails as busy. Nobody acts as an app coder.

skill.description: Optional: only agents with this skill id (substring match).
